newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 11.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

CHINA TIMES - Taiwan Semiconductor plans to build six advanced wafer-fabrication plants as part of a T$400 billion (US$14.5 billion) investment at southern Taiwan's Tainan Science-based Industrial Park.
Two naval frigates collide during training.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Chinese Petroleum Corp reports a leak in a fuel oil pipeline at its northern Taoyuan refinery.
Government agencies hold confidential meeting to discuss possible easing of direct contacts across the Taiwan strait.
LIBERTY TIMES - Foreign ministry officials in secret North Korea mission, first official contact between two countries.
U.S. demonstrates new generation F-22 fighter jet.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan citizens' overseas incomes to be taxed here.
U.S. wants to export pork to Taiwan amid hog foot-and-mouth disease.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Fifteen Taiwan-made products rank number one in world.
Taiwan mulls alternatives for direct (Taiwan-China) air links.
